messages:
Aisha: Pelotonix just confirmed they're targeting our Q4 GA but have 2 hard requirements: in-region EU private deployment and KMS/HSM key separation. They want dates by EOD.
Julian: Got it. Do we have a draft timeline that ties Dedicated + Private deploy steps? Need to call out rollout gates (SOC2 audit, KMS integration, e2e perf run).
Rina: Quick status — eng runway for Private installs is slot-constrained. We can do a minimal EU private by +8 weeks if we cut optional items (no on-prem data plane, use VPC-only). Full on-prem would be +14 weeks.
Diego: For the KMS ask — we can support customer-managed keys via our KMS shim. Implementation work: KMS shim (2wk), HSM test harness (1wk), integration + e2e (1wk). Can parallelize with infra provisioning.
Aisha: Pelotonix insists on dedicated capacity with 99.9% read SLA and <120ms p50 for generation at 512 tokens. They said no go without SLA. Can we commit?
Rina: 99.9% is doable on Dedicated if we reserve pool and metric-backed autoscale. Latency target needs load-profile validation — ask Pelotonix for representative traffic and prompt distribution.
Sam: Customer success note — Pelotonix will require an acceptance checklist (visibility, billing reports, traffic shaping, incident contacts). Also they want a canary test window with production traffic replay.
Julian: Proposed plan outline for Aisha to share with customer:
- Phase 0 (Week 0-1): Contract + security questionnaire
- Phase 1 (Week 1-4): VPC provisioning, KMS shim dev kickoff, reserved Dedicated capacity planning
- Phase 2 (Week 4-8): KMS integration, perf tuning, SOC2 evidence collection
- Phase 3 (Week 8-10): Canary + acceptance tests, SLA signoff
If Pelotonix accepts VPC-only Private (not full on-prem), target GA = Week 10.
Aisha: Pelotonix responded: VPC-only is acceptable if we support KMS separation and provide guaranteed burst capacity. They'll sign if GA <= 10 weeks.
Diego: Workarounds if we need to shorten — temporary policy: route EU queries to a nearby hosted pool with encryption-at-rest + KMS proxy until full Private is live. That buys 3-4 weeks.
Rina: Resource ask: need 1 infra eng + 1 platform eng full-time for weeks 1-6, 0.5 SWE for KMS shim. Can we confirm staffing?
Julian: I'll flag as priority in roadmap and coordinate with Eng leads. @Rina please spec minimal acceptance criteria and a short perf benchmark tool we can run against their sample prompts.
Sam: I'll collect the sample traffic & acceptance rubric from Pelotonix today and drop in the repo.
deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance window in eu-west-1 on week 3 — may affect canary timing. @Julian FYI.
Aisha: Action items: 1) Julian to confirm staffing and commit by EOD tomorrow; 2) Rina to post minimal acceptance checklist; 3) Sam to fetch traffic samples. Pelotonix asked for a firm GA date in writing once we confirm staffing.
Julian: I'll follow up with staffing confirmation by 18:00 UTC tomorrow. If we get infra staff, we can commit Week 10 GA with the VPC-only option. Otherwise we'll propose the hosted-proxy interim plan.
Aisha: Thanks — sharing update with Pelotonix now. :thumbsup:
